statement: For an actual closed-disk relative loop commuting with a closed free proper one-dimensional interior operator group, the restriction to the closed set consisting of the original circle, all common-base-fixed lines, and the specified retained principal strips has an actual based contraction with continuous inverses. Retained strips either have zero characters at all finite endpoints or have a nonzero finite-endpoint character vanishing on a base-point stabilizer. The latter forces the exact translation base coordinate, while both finite endpoint displacements are prescribed simultaneously as r times the original displacement. One compact family of actual original maps controls all evaluations, including infinitely varying strips and the original circle. The actual restriction homomorphism is given explicitly; when every strip is retained this contracts the loop in its original relative centralizer.
depends_on: C33 actual principal coordinates and every component operator; C75 exact endpoint characters and translation comparison; C37 planar three-word identity; C62 triangle containment for equal-real-level fiber intervals; C63 compact product and relative interlaced convex selection, with the new simultaneous-character lower-limit comparison proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), actual endpoint-prescribed and original-boundary-controlled continuation of the dimension-one proper-operator reduction.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual endpoint vector image is proved to be a real vector space before taking closure. Six actual short increments cover a neighborhood of zero in that image, and three original prefix letters realize every required fractional endpoint vector. No continuous section of a character map or quotient-topology identification is assumed.
computational_checks: The new result is a qualitative compact-family and continuous-selection theorem. Its source-word counts, character equalities, operator equations, explicit inverse maps, and all limiting comparisons are proved directly; no numerical approximation or finite classification is used.
notes: Both finite endpoint characters are imposed at once, and the base-forcing equation holds for every actual selected label. Arbitrary accumulation at interior lines and the original circle is controlled. The closed-subset filling is not asserted to lift through the actual restriction homomorphism when strips remain excluded. Those excluded strips have full-real nonzero endpoint-stabilizer images; a continuous controlled lift there remains unresolved. Accepted earlier fragments are unchanged.
